html:
Charlotte, NC, March 28, 2017 — Charlie Company Media, of Charlotte, NC has joined the National Association of the Remodeling Industry (NARI) as a Bronze Industry Partner and sponsor. NARI is a national association that is made up of 6,000+ residential remodeling contractors nationwide.

Charlie Company Media will be a featured business partner alongside companies like The Home Depot and FCA, and will also be featured on NARI’s Industry Partner page as an online marketing resource for members. Charlie Company Media works directly with remodeling contractors by giving them a total digital presence to help them get found online, attract customers, and grow their business. Charlie Company Media and NARI will collaborate on various events and webinars to educate NARI members and ensure the overall success of the partnership.

The CEO of NARI is equally excited about the partnership, and the benefits for his members. There will be plenty of opportunity for his members to learn a great deal about marketing, and what they can do to improve their businesses. Charlie Company Media is happy to be instrumental in the education and improvement and growth of small to medium size business owners.

About Charlie Company Media

Charlie Company Media is a division of Charlie Company Holdings, Inc. one of the nation’s largest media companies. Charlie Company Media is a digital marketing and solutions organization that specializes in creating the total web presence small businesses need to make sure they reach their online audience. When clients partner with Charlie Company Media, they choose a team of industry-leading experts. Currently, Charlie Company Media serves 10,000+ clients on a month-to-month basis. FFor more information, visit charliecompanymedia.com.

About NARI

The National Association of the Remodeling Industry, or NARI, is the medium for business development, a platform for advocacy and the principal source for industry intelligence. NARI connects homeowners with its professional members and provides tips and tricks so that the consumer has a positive remodeling experience. For more information, visit nari.org.
